fields.description: Oasiz 2 is a separate apartment building in Dubai Silicon Oasis. Its plans distinguish conventional homes from presidential layouts with pools, with larger family apartments on the upper residential levels.

sources.label: Oasiz 2 branded 23-page plan pack, broker mirror

reviewCoverage.identity: Oasiz 2 identity checked against its own project page and named plan documents; related phases are separated.
reviewCoverage.location: The sources identify Dubai Silicon Oasis, Dubai. No coordinates or guaranteed travel times were invented.
reviewCoverage.residences: The published Studio–3 range was checked against the named layout families; convertible spaces are not counted as extra bedrooms.
reviewCoverage.areas: Numeric plan panels were rendered and visually inspected. Apartment, balcony and total figures are kept distinct; source conflicts are disclosed below.
reviewCoverage.amenities: Project facilities were checked against the cited own page or phase-specific guide. Unit pools are limited to the layouts that show them.
reviewCoverage.pricing: The price basis and source are disclosed. Historical launch references, averages and current availability are not treated as interchangeable.
reviewCoverage.payment: Freshownhero30/70 andgeneric1%monthlylanguage compared withPF10/54/6/30post. Stagesareportalreference only,headlinewithheld; no universalcurrentcalendar.
reviewCoverage.handover: Forecast dates are separated from dated construction assessments; no actual handover is inferred from a percentage or elapsed forecast.
reviewCoverage.documents: Named brochures, plans and available commercial documents were reviewed. Numeric evidence, phase distinctions and document allocations are recorded in the project artifact.

overview: Upper-level three-bedroom plans differ from the smaller homes below. Compare the chosen floor, pool responsibilities and enclosed accommodation before using a marketing total as a measure of everyday space.
research.locationNote: Dubai Silicon Oasis, Dubai. A proposed Metro reference is future connectivity; verify the actual route and transport status before relying on it.
research.priceNote: The own Oasiz 2 FAQ retains studios around AED 699,000, while its main availability label says sold out. Property Finder retains an AED 769,000 launch reference. Neither is a current selected-unit quotation; resale and later payment offers can differ.
research.paymentNote: Danube’s live hero advertises 30/70, while its page also uses 1% monthly language without a complete dated schedule. Property Finder instead allocates 10% launch, 54% construction, 6% handover and 30% afterward. The displayed stages are that portal reference only; its two options repeat these percentages. Obtain the actual selected-unit agreement and instalment calendar.
research.handoverNote: Danube forecasts November 2027. Its internal inspection dated 30 September 2026 reports 35% progress and a concrete slab at floor 17. This developer snapshot establishes neither completion nor a guaranteed handover date.

facts.value: 483 apartments on the own Oasiz 2 page; this is not available inventory.

unresolved: Printed area ranges are marketing bands, not selected-unit approved measurements. Private pools and presidential labels apply only to specified layouts.

Current dated prices, payment deadlines, post-handover conditions, parking allocation, approved service charges, furnishing inventory and pool maintenance obligations require selected-unit confirmation. Images remain illustrative.
